reviews.text: Disappointed. I have been involved in animal rescue for about 15 years and have dealt with many vets across the country. I’m relatively new to Phoenix and was referred to Alta Vista. Every time I come in for an appointment I’m here for approximately 3 hours which is not feasible with as often as I come in for as many sick animals as I have. Especially watching others come and go. It seems like I am put on the back burner. Even when asking if I can drop off, I find myself waiting for upwards of an hour. I have also noticed that every ailment comes with a recommended treatment of the most expensive and advanced diagnostics. If you’re like me, I’m inclined to do anything the vet recommends. And it’s difficult when those recommendations are upwards of $500 in testing each time. I want to love this place but I just feel that my time and my finances are not respected.

This office is very unprofessional with the animals and people and I don’t recommend coming here. I want to start by saying it’s surprising to me that Alta Vista Veterinary has less than 4 stars on google. The treatment and care they showed me and my cat was exceptional, and for an excellent price as well.

My cat developed ringworm, which was very distressing as I had an urgent trip coming up shortly after his diagnosis and I would be unable to properly treat him while I was gone. Every animal sitter I called turned him down due to his condition (understandably so), but the real surprise was that I called about 13-15 other veterinary hospitals and medical boarding facilities in the area, and all of them refused to let him in. Even facilities that claimed to offer “Quarantine Boarding” refused because they were afraid they would still be unable to properly keep the ringworm from spreading to other pets or employees.

A day prior to my trip, I spoke with Angie at Alta Vista, and she assured me that they would be able to put him up for medical boarding and give him treatment while I was away. Not only this, but they were able to do so for only $60 a night (I was expecting $120+). I was able to drop him off same day and go on my trip, which was a huge relief and allowed me to enjoy my trip knowing he was in good hands.

When I got back, pickup took about 5 minutes, and the staff were extremely kind and informative, even after having to care for a pet with a highly contagious infection.

All this to say, if you have a similar situation to me, I highly, HIGHLY recommend Alta Vista. I rarely review places, but this is one that I needed to give.
Thank you for your review—we appreciate your support! If there’s anything we could have done to make your experience even better, we’d love to hear your feedback.

I’ve been a customer of Alta Vista Veterinary and expected a much higher level of care with their boarding center — especially after paying for VIP boarding services that included baths for both of my dogs over the 4th of July weekend. What I got instead was completely unacceptable and honestly, heartbreaking.

When I picked them up, they were covered in urine, and their beds were soaked. My Shipoo, whose coat I work hard to maintain, was severely matted with knots all over his body. I had to pay to get him completely shaved after a year of taking care of his coat. Despite the VIP package including a bath, I was told he had been bathed earlier in the stay — not the day of pickup — which meant I brought him home filthy and neglected.

Even worse, both of my dogs were visibly traumatized and had bug bite marks all over their bodies. When I called to share my concerns, I was told they had 50–60 dogs that weekend and “didn’t have time to brush them.” That is not an acceptable excuse when you are charging for premium-level care.

I asked to speak with a manager and was promised a call back — no one ever followed up. That silence speaks volumes about the level of accountability at this facility.

You didn’t just lose me as a boarding client — you’ve lost me entirely. I will never bring my pets here again, not even for veterinary care. This experience has made me seriously question the ethics, integrity, and standards of your entire operation. Pets are family — and they deserve far better than what mine experienced here.

I had been a long standing customer here for multiple pets. They were fine each time, until the last time. I took my new puppy to get fixed here. I was working from home at the time so I was able to be with him all day each day. He was never alone, and as a hyper breed of dog I made sure he was taking meds to minimize his activity. But something was wrong. His wound would not heal. I started to feel like something was off, and also was concerned about keeping him medicated for an extended period. He was past the anticipated heal date, but there was still a small hole that wouldn’t close no matter what. It would heal at night and then open again during the day.

So I took him in two other times and both times they just gave me more meds, that I paid for, office visit fees I had to pay for, and implied that there was something I was doing wrong at home. After over a month of this, one day I found an extremely sharp piece of plastic slightly protruding from the incision site!!! I took him in immediately to have them remove it. I was so upset that this could happen!!! I am not a medical professional, these people charge ludicrous amounts of money for completely inept service—he was overlooked on the day of his surgery and two follow up appointments.

At this appointment to remove the plastic piece, they waived the fee for the visit and procedure but told m e I had to pay for more medication, and would not reimburse me for the two prior visits that I only had to make due to their inadequate actions. I was beside myself. I left without paying for the meds in protest to their horrendous service. And guess what they did to me? They called the cops!!!!!

These people are bad actors. I’m sure good people work here but this experience was horrifying for me, risked my dogs life with infection, and instead of facing up to their mistake and making it right, they charged me more money and called the police. The police should be called on these people for stealing money from people for services not rendered and causing injury when they are the ones who are supposed to be helping animals heal. They are lucky I didn’t sue. If you care about your pet and your sanity do not go to Alta vista!

I just have to give a huge thanks to the staff at Alta Vista. Over the weekend lost our pup Jojo of 17 years. We knew her time was coming soon, and we had many checkups and tough conversations with Alta along the way. Even though it was expected, the loss still hit our family very hard. I can't overstate how thankful I am for their compassion, understanding, patience, availability and responsiveness. After her passing, they were ready to communicate next steps and options. Just today we received a card signed by the staff with very sweet messages of condolences, that was a very nice touch.  Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

We have been taking our dogs to Alta Vista (both vet + boarding) since moving to Phoenix in 2021. With one of our dogs being a senior, it was extremely important to us that we found a place that could replicate the care and support we received from our veterinarian from where we were moving from. While I do think that the staff here are sometime overworked (as are most vet staffs) and it is fair that folks call this out in their reviews, I do think it is a bit unfair the level of critique given. Just because staff might not be as “warm” towards you as a human being, does not mean the level of care given to your pet is lacking. As someone who was a vet tech for a bit in my lifetime, most often folks who don’t necessarily love people, are the ones who are pulled to animal care and excel at it.

Additionally as someone who has worked in the veterinary world, the pricing and approach to money at Alta Vista is second to none. I have never worked at, or been a patron of, a vet that is more fair and honest with their pricing.

Veterinarian offices are a business, but Alta Vista never once has pushed us into getting unwarranted procedures, medicine or care for our animals which is a stark contrast to others. Their recommendations are fair and customer/pet focused, and they have on multiple occasions let me know that concerns that I have had are not necessarily based in reality. Most importantly, they never prey on your emotions, or make you feel guilty regarding money.

Most notably they have let me know that cosmetic growths are not something that need to be removed if not a burden to our dogs (unheard of if you went to another vet, they would have gladly pushed for the surgery and taken the money) that an ACL tear on a small senior dog should be monitored instead of immediately having a $$$$ surgery (again unheard of; a lot of vets would have gladly charged the money without considering mitigating factors) and that dental cleanings should be affordable! Our senior dog with terrible teeth (genetic and poor puppy planning) needed a majority of his teeth pulled for less than $1k - a stark comparison to teeth pulling (3 teeth) and cleaning prior at our “home vet” which charged $3k for that.

Alta Vista cares for your pets, is fair in pricing (almost to a fault of themselves) and are kind, available and courteous. We will be moving in the next couple of years and will be so hard pressed to find someone who operates at this level going forward. I urge folks who read the poor reviews here to keep a realistic lens and know that emotions are valid, but not necessarily fair or accurate in reviews.
